column1: # TSE municipality code <-> IBGE municipality code crosswalk (2022 electoral universe).
# WHY: TSE and IBGE are different code spaces (Boa Vista is TSE 03018
# 1400100).  Every geographic join in this project -- centroids today
# choropleth topojson later -- goes through this file.  A wrong row silently
# puts a municipality in the wrong place on the map
# verified against IBGE's own catalogue
# SOURCES
#   TSE<->IBGE pairs : https://raw.githubusercontent.com/betafcc/Municipios-Brasileiros-TSE/master/municipios_brasileiros_tse.csv
#                      (community compilation of TSE's municipality table)
#   IBGE catalogue   : https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/v1/localidades/municipios
#                      (official names + UF per IBGE code) -- fetched 2026-08-04
# VERIFICATION (all of it re-runnable from the two URLs above)
#   * 5 570 rows: every IBGE municipality that existed for the 2022 election.
#     IBGE lists 5 571; the extra one
#     created after 2022 and has never held an election
#     no TSE code.
#   * TSE codes unique nationally; IBGE codes unique; UF agrees with IBGE for
#     every row.
#   * 5 532 rows have an exact (accent/case-insensitive) name match with IBGE.
#   * 7 rows were MIS-PAIRED in the upstream file (a name-sorted zip that
#     drifted): 5 in BA (LAGOA REAL / LAJE / LAJEDAO / LAJEDINHO / LAJEDO DO
#     TABOCAL rotated among each other's IBGE codes) and 2 in SC (SANTA
#     TEREZINHA DO PROGRESSO <-> SANTIAGO DO SUL swapped).  Each is repaired
#     here to the unique same-UF IBGE municipality carrying that exact name --
#     which is also what restores a bijection.  `match=repaired`.
#   * 31 rows keep the upstream pairing because TSE's name is a legitimate
#     variant or a pre-rename name and no other municipality in that UF carries
#     it (e.g. AP AGUA BRANCA DO AMAPARI -> Pedra Branca do Amapari
#     PB SANTAREM -> Joca Claudino
# COLUMNS
#   tse_code   5-char zero-padded TEXT
#   uf         federative unit
#   ibge_code  7-digit IBGE municipality code
#   tse_name   name as TSE spells it
#   ibge_name  name as IBGE spells it
#   match      exact | repaired | variant  (see VERIFICATION)
